interim_looks.stopping_action: Early stopping permitted ONLY for overwhelming early superiority (Z >= 2.96). If candidate recall drops by > 2*delta (Delta R < -0.10), suspend shadow testing for model defect analysis.
Evaluate futility. If candidate recall is significantly inferior or if Delta R < -0.10, terminate candidate testing. Early promotion permitted if Z >= 2.14.
Confirmatory non-inferiority evaluation submitted to Model Risk Committee. Promotion requires Z >= 1.71 (p < 0.0440) alongside operational criteria.

governance_and_stopping_rules.type_I_error_control: Overall one-sided alpha = 0.05 strictly preserved across all 3 looks by Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming spending.
governance_and_stopping_rules.peeking_ban: Unplanned significance testing between scheduled interim looks is strictly prohibited. Continuous monitoring is restricted to exploratory operational telemetry.
governance_and_stopping_rules.futility_safety_rule: If at Look 1 or Look 2, candidate recall is observed to be strictly inferior to baseline by more than 2*delta (Delta R < -0.10 for delta=0.05), surveillance is immediately suspended.
governance_and_stopping_rules.information_fraction_definition: Information fraction t_k = N_distress,k / N_max = N_k / 60. Information accumulates strictly with confirmed, audited failure events, not with healthy non-events.
